1.english_reference: And it came to pass a long time after

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי֙ מִ יָּמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο μεθ᾽ ἡμέρας πλείους
traditions.VUL: Evolúto autem multo témpore ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass a long time after

1.english_reference: that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about

traditions.WLC: אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר הֵנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֧ה לְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִ כָּל אֹיְבֵי הֶ֖ם מִ סָּבִ֑יב
traditions.LXX: μετὰ τὸ καταπαῦσαι Κύριον τὸν Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν κυκλόθεν ,
traditions.VUL: postquam pacem déderat Dóminus Israéli , subiéctis in gyro natiónibus univérsis ,
traditions.KJV: that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about ,

1.english_reference: that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age

traditions.WLC: וִ יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּ יָּמִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰησοῦς πρεσβύτερος προβεβηκὼς ταῖς ἡμέραις .
traditions.VUL: et Iósue iam longǽvo , et persenílis ætátis :
traditions.KJV: that Joshua waxed old [ and ] stricken in age .

2.english_reference: And Joshua called for all Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָ֤א יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ לְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνεκάλεσεν Ἰησοῦς πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: vocávit Iósue omnem Israélem ,
traditions.KJV: And Joshua called for all Israel , [ and ]

2.english_reference: for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers

traditions.WLC: לִ זְקֵנָי ו֙ וּ לְ רָאשָׁ֔י ו וּ לְ שֹׁפְטָ֖י ו וּ לְ שֹֽׁטְרָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν γερουσίαν αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς γραμματεῖς αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς δικαστὰς αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: maiorésque natu , et príncipes ac duces , et magístros ,
traditions.KJV: for their elders , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers ,

traditions.WLC: ו וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς
traditions.VUL: dixítque ad eos :
traditions.KJV: and said unto them ,

2.english_reference: I am old and stricken in age

traditions.WLC: אֲנִ֣י זָקַ֔נְתִּי בָּ֖אתִי בַּ יָּמִֽים
traditions.LXX: Ἐγὼ γεγήρακα καὶ προβέβηκα ταῖς ἡμέραις .
traditions.VUL: Ego sénui , et progressióris ætátis sum :
traditions.KJV: I am old [ and ] stricken in age :

3.english_reference: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֗ם אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶ֛ם לְ כָל הַ גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ אֵ֖לֶּה מִ פְּנֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ὑμεῖς δὲ ἑοράκατε ὅσα ἐποίησεν Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τούτοις ἀπὸ προσώπου ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: vosque cérnitis ómnia , quæ fécerit Dóminus Deus vester cunctis per circúitum natiónibus ,
traditions.KJV: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you ;

3.english_reference: for the LORD your God is he that hath fought for you

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶ֔ם ה֖וּא הַ נִּלְחָ֥ם לָ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ὁ ἐκπολεμήσας ἡμῖν .
traditions.VUL: quómodo pro vobis ipse pugnáverit :
traditions.KJV: for the LORD your God [ is ] he that hath fought for you .

5.english_reference: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight

traditions.WLC: וַ יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי כֶ֗ם ה֚וּא יֶהְדֳּפֵ֣ ם מִ פְּנֵי כֶ֔ם וְ הוֹרִ֥ישׁ אֹתָ֖ ם מִ לִּ פְנֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Κύριος δὲ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν , οὗτος ἐξολεθρεύσει αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ προσώπου ἡμῶν , ἕως ἂν ἀπόλωνται · καὶ ἀποστελεῖ αὐτοῖς τὰ θηρία τὰ ἄγρια , ἕως ἂν ἐξολεθρεύσῃ αὐτοὺς καὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Dóminus Deus vester dispérdet eas et áuferet a fácie vestra ,
traditions.KJV: And the LORD your God , he shall expel them from before you , and drive them from out of your sight ;

5.english_reference: and ye shall possess their land

traditions.WLC: וִֽ ירִשְׁתֶּם֙ אֶת אַרְצָ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατακληρονομήσατε τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et possidébitis terram ,
traditions.KJV: and ye shall possess their land ,

5.english_reference: as the LORD your God hath promised unto you

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶ֖ם לָ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καθὰ ἐλάλησεν Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ὑμῖν .
traditions.VUL: sicut vobis pollícitus est .
traditions.KJV: as the LORD your God hath promised unto you .

6.english_reference: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses

traditions.WLC: וַ חֲזַקְתֶּ֣ם מְאֹ֔ד לִ שְׁמֹ֣ר וְ לַ עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ כָּת֔וּב בְּ סֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֑ה
traditions.LXX: κατισχύσατε οὖν σφόδρα φυλάσσειν καὶ ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου Μωυσῆ ,
traditions.VUL: Tantum confortámini , et estóte sollíciti , ut custodiátis cuncta quæ scripta sunt in volúmine legis Móysi :
traditions.KJV: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses ,

6.english_reference: that ye turn not aside therefrom the right hand or the left

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּ֥י סוּר מִמֶּ֖ נּוּ יָמִ֥ין וּ שְׂמֹֽאול
traditions.LXX: ἵνα μὴ ἐκκλίνητε εἰς δεξιὰν ἢ εὐώνυμα .
traditions.VUL: et non declinétis ab eis neque ad déxteram neque ad sinístram :
traditions.KJV: that ye turn not aside therefrom [ to ] the right hand or [ to ] the left ;

7.english_reference: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּי בוֹא֙ בַּ גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ אֵ֔לֶּה הַ נִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָ אֵ֖לֶּה אִתְּ כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ὅπως μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὰ ἔθνη τὰ καταλελιμμένα ταῦτα ·
traditions.VUL: ne postquam intravéritis ad gentes , quæ inter vos futúræ sunt ,
traditions.KJV: That ye come not among these nations , these that remain among you ;

7.english_reference: neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ שֵׁ֨ם אֱלֹהֵי הֶ֤ם לֹא תַזְכִּ֨ירוּ֙ וְ לֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֔יעוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν θεῶν αὐτῶν οὐκ ὀνομασθήσεται ἐν ὑμῖν ·
traditions.VUL: iurétis in nómine deórum eárum ,
traditions.KJV: neither make mention of the name of their gods , nor cause to swear [ by them ] ,

7.english_reference: neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֣א תַעַבְד֔וּ ם וְ לֹ֥א תִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָ הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: οὐ μὴ προσκυνήσετε αὐτοῖς οὐδὲ μὴ λατρεύσετε αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: et serviátis eis , et adorétis illos :
traditions.KJV: neither serve them , nor bow yourselves unto them :

8.english_reference: But cleave unto the LORD your God

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י אִם בַּ יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶ֖ם תִּדְבָּ֑קוּ
traditions.LXX: ἀλλὰ Κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν προσκολληθήσεσθε ,
traditions.VUL: sed adhæreátis Dómino Deo vestro :
traditions.KJV: But cleave unto the LORD your God ,

8.english_reference: as ye have done unto this day

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ יּ֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: καθάπερ ἐποιήσατε ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης .
traditions.VUL: quod fecístis usque in diem hanc .
traditions.KJV: as ye have done unto this day .

9.english_reference: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong

traditions.WLC: וַ יּ֤וֹרֶשׁ יְהוָה֙ מִ פְּנֵי כֶ֔ם גּוֹיִ֖ם גְּדֹלִ֣ים וַ עֲצוּמִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσει αὐτοὺς Κύριος ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν , ἔθνη μεγάλα καὶ ἰσχυρά ,
traditions.VUL: Et tunc áuferet Dóminus Deus in conspéctu vestro gentes magnas et robustíssimas ,
traditions.KJV: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong :

9.english_reference: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּ֗ם לֹא עָ֤מַד אִישׁ֙ בִּ פְנֵי כֶ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ יּ֥וֹם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐθεὶς ἀντέστη κατενώπιον ἡμῶν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης ·
traditions.VUL: et nullus vobis resístere póterit .
traditions.KJV: but [ as for ] you , no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day .

10.english_reference: One man of you shall chase a thousand

traditions.WLC: אִישׁ אֶחָ֥ד מִ כֶּ֖ם יִרְדָּף אָ֑לֶף
traditions.LXX: εἷς ὑμῶν ἐδίωξεν χιλίους ,
traditions.VUL: Unus e vobis persequétur hóstium mille viros :
traditions.KJV: One man of you shall chase a thousand :

10.english_reference: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶ֗ם ה֚וּא הַ נִּלְחָ֣ם לָ כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐξεπολέμει ἡμῖν ,
traditions.VUL: quia Dóminus Deus vester pro vobis ipse pugnábit ,
traditions.KJV: for the LORD your God , he [ it is ] that fighteth for you ,

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καθάπερ εἶπεν ἡμῖν .
traditions.VUL: sicut pollícitus est .
traditions.KJV: as he hath promised you .

11.english_reference: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves , that ye love the LORD your God .

traditions.WLC: וְ נִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְ נַפְשֹֽׁתֵי כֶ֑ם לְ אַהֲבָ֖ה אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ φυλάξασθε σφόδρα τοῦ ἀγαπᾷν Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν .
traditions.VUL: Hoc tantum diligentíssime præcavéte : ut diligátis Dóminum Deum vestrum .
traditions.KJV: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves , that ye love the LORD your God .

13.english_reference: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out [ any of ] these nations from before you ;

traditions.WLC: יָד֨וֹעַ֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוֹסִ֜יף יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶ֗ם לְ הוֹרִ֛ישׁ אֶת הַ גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ אֵ֖לֶּה מִ לִּ פְנֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: γινώσκετε ὅτι οὐ μὴ προσθῇ Κύριος τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι τὰ ἔθνη ταῦτα ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν ·
traditions.VUL: iam nunc scitóte quod Dóminus Deus vester non eas déleat ante fáciem vestram ,
traditions.KJV: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out [ any of ] these nations from before you ;

13.english_reference: but they shall be snares and traps unto you ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הָי֨וּ לָ כֶ֜ם לְ פַ֣ח וּ לְ מוֹקֵ֗שׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσονται ὑμῖν εἰς παγίδας καὶ εἰς σκάνδαλα
traditions.VUL: sed sint vobis in fóveam ac láqueum ,
traditions.KJV: but they shall be snares and traps unto you ,

13.english_reference: and scourges in your sides , and thorns in your eyes ,

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ שֹׁטֵ֤ט בְּ צִדֵּי כֶם֙ וְ לִ צְנִנִ֣ים בְּ עֵינֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰς ἥλους ἐν ταῖς πτέρναις ὑμῶν καὶ εἰς βολίδας ἐν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et offendículum ex látere vestro , et sudes in óculis vestris ,
traditions.KJV: and scourges in your sides , and thorns in your eyes ,

13.english_reference: until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you .

traditions.WLC: עַד אֲבָדְ כֶ֗ם מֵ֠ עַל הָ אֲדָמָ֤ה הַ טּוֹבָה֙ הַ זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָ כֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ἕως ἂν ἀπόλησθε ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς τῆς ἀγαθῆς ταύτης ἣν ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν .
traditions.VUL: donec vos áuferat atque dispérdat de terra hac óptima , quam trádidit vobis .
traditions.KJV: until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you .

14.english_reference: And , behold , this day I [ am ] going the way of all the earth :

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י הוֹלֵךְ֙ הַ יּ֔וֹם בְּ דֶ֖רֶךְ כָּל הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: ἐγὼ δὲ ἀποτρέχω τὴν ὁδὸν καθὰ καὶ πὰντες οἱ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ·
traditions.VUL: En ego hódie ingrédior viam univérsæ terræ ,
traditions.KJV: And , behold , this day I [ am ] going the way of all the earth :

14.english_reference: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls ,

traditions.WLC: וִ ידַעְתֶּ֞ם בְּ כָל לְבַבְ כֶ֣ם וּ בְ כָל נַפְשְׁ כֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσεσθε τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν καὶ τῇ ψυχῇ ὑμῶν
traditions.VUL: et toto ánimo cognoscétis
traditions.KJV: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls ,

14.english_reference: that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י לֹֽא נָפַל֩ דָּבָ֨ר אֶחָ֜ד מִ כֹּ֣ל הַ דְּבָרִ֣ים הַ טּוֹבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶם֙ עֲלֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: διότι οὐκ ἔπεσεν εἷς λόγος ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν λόγων ὧν εἶπεν Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν πρὸς πάντα τὰ ἀνήκοντα ἡμῖν ,
traditions.VUL: quod de ómnibus verbis , quæ se Dóminus præstitúrum vobis esse pollícitus est , unum non præteríerit incássum .
traditions.KJV: that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you ;

14.english_reference: all are come to pass unto you , [ and ] not one thing hath failed thereof .

traditions.WLC: הַ כֹּל֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ כֶ֔ם לֹֽא נָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖ נּוּ דָּבָ֥ר אֶחָֽד
traditions.LXX: οὐ διεφώνησεν ἐξ αὐτῶν .
traditions.KJV: all are come to pass unto you , [ and ] not one thing hath failed thereof .

15.english_reference: Therefore it shall come to pass , [ that ] as all good things are come upon you , which the LORD your God promised you ;

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֗ה כַּ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֤א עֲלֵי כֶם֙ כָּל הַ דָּבָ֣ר הַ טּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶ֖ם אֲלֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον ἥκει πρὸς ἡμᾶς πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τὰ καλὰ ἃ ἐλάλησεν Κύριος πρὸς ἡμᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: Sicut ergo implévit ópere quod promísit , et próspera cuncta venérunt :
traditions.KJV: Therefore it shall come to pass , [ that ] as all good things are come upon you , which the LORD your God promised you ;

15.english_reference: so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things ,

traditions.WLC: כֵּן֩ יָבִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵי כֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ דָּבָ֣ר הָ רָ֔ע
traditions.LXX: οὕτως ἐπάξει Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τὰ πονηρά ,
traditions.VUL: sic addúcet super vos quidquid malórum comminátus est ,
traditions.KJV: so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things ,

15.english_reference: until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you .

traditions.WLC: עַד הַשְׁמִיד֣ וֹ אוֹתְ כֶ֗ם מֵ֠ עַל הָ אֲדָמָ֤ה הַ טּוֹבָה֙ הַ זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָ כֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ἕως ἂν ἐξολεθρεύσῃ ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς τῆς ἀγαθῆς ταύτης ἧς ἔδωκεν Κύριος ὑμῖν ,
traditions.VUL: donec vos áuferat atque dispérdat de terra hac óptima , quam trádidit vobis ,
traditions.KJV: until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you .

16.english_reference: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God , which he commanded you ,
